note: This round falls between lighting snapshots 282136c/9f2d20e and the next lighting commit. regressed: Lighting, not ceiling code: the downward-facing lip/handhold strip under the outboard bin door fell from L about 140 (r8 v9) to about 85 (r9 v9), and from 138 to 83 in v4. It now reads as a dark grey band along every outboard bin bottom (v1, v4, v9, v10). Studio e_obin shows the same strip light, so the cause is the new crevice term amb *= mix(0.4,1,smoothstep(.06,.5,ao)) and the lower AO weight on faces that do not look up.
Lighting, not ceiling code: at exposure 1.38 the bin doors in q06/v8 clip to near-white with almost no form shading. c120 bins carry soft blue-grey shading at 170-200.

issues.fix: For lighting (04_shaders.js): limit the crevice term amb *= mix(0.4,1,smoothstep(.06,.5,ao)) to the dense seat block, or floor it at about 0.75 on the 'upper' layer (meshes in layer 'upper' from 08_bins.js). Do not retune BINMAT to compensate.

issues.problem: The icons beside the row number read as 3-4 solid dashes ('35 ===='). c120 shows two distinct pictograms, a seat outline with a letter panel and a standing person. They also have a fixed count instead of n per seat.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js paintBinDecals: draw at most 2 icons, a seat in side view (backrest at about 70 deg plus cushion, ic = 16 virtual px, stroke 2.5) and a person (head circle plus torso), instead of Math.min(n,4) seatIcon bars. Keep the stretch sx.

issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js vault speaker: drop the slat layer (or bring its amplitude below 0.03), and darken only a 6 mm strip along the forward long edge.

issues.fix: Either raise the AO volume resolution in x across the vault in 12_scene.js (lighting), or subdivide the vault more finely in 07b_ceiling.js (N 48 -> 72) if the streaks follow the facet normals.
